picks.title: Japan’s most powerful supercomputer may have been hacked, over 4,000 users’ personal data stolen
picks.summary: Fugaku, Japan s most powerful supercomputer, has suffered a suspected data breach, with the information of more than 4,000 of its users potentially stolen as a result.

picks.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says

picks.title: Ransomware Attacks Increase Behind AI, But Payments Decline
